articles.headline: How Iowa ended up with Van Hayden, college football's most unique cover band
articles.description: A group of Hawkeyes fans decided to learn Van Halen covers as a bit. Now they're the life of the party on game days.

images.name: Van Hayden - LEDE [1296x729]
images.caption: Monday through Friday, they fill prescriptions, write code, consult on health plans and restore historic homes. On Saturdays in Iowa City, they put on white pants, aviators and fake mustaches, climb into a retired ambulance and become Van Hayden.

images.name: 01 - Van Hayden Inline [2000x4043]
images.caption: Legendary Iowa coach Hayden Fry wanted the Hawkeyes to look good, and rock gods Van Halen packed arenas. The spirit of both '80s icons combine at Van Hayden's tailgate concerts.
images.credit: AP Photo/Reed Saxon, Mary Beth Koeth for ESPN, Fin Costello/Redferns

images.name: 02 - Van Hayden Inline [8031x5357]
images.caption: Andy Olson (Eddie Van Hayden), Jake Olson (Alex Van Hayden), 15-year-old Masen Funk (The Pasadena Kid) and Brent Buresh (Michael Van Hayden) lay down the grooves while Robby Marvin, front, gets the crowd going as Hayden Lee Roth.

images.name: 03 - Van Hayden Inline [2000x2674]
images.caption: Four-year-old Sofia Thieleane Raecker, with her grandfather Steve Raecker, planned ahead and brought her own guitar to the family tailgate at the Dental Science Building in anticipation of Van Hayden's appearance before the Ohio State game.

images.name: 04 - Van Hayden Inline [2000x4043]
images.caption: Van Hayden makes several tailgate stops a day in multiple lots, including for a gathering of Fry's former players (top). The band has its own devotees, including Brandon Snell (middle), who wore a Van Hayden shirt and Zubaz pants to see them play.

article.headline: CUSA matchup features Liberty against Sam Houston
article.description: Sam Houston (1-3) at Liberty (4-1), Oct. 8 at 7 p.m. EDT.
article.title: CUSA matchup features Liberty against Sam Houston
article.linkText: CUSA matchup features Liberty against Sam Houston
article.story: Sam Houston (1-3) at Liberty (4-1), Oct. 8 at 7 p.m. EDT. Opening Line: Liberty by 13.5. Against the spread: Liberty 3-2, Sam Houston 3-1. How to watch: ESPNU Key stats Liberty Offense Overall: 416.8 yards per game (53rd in FBS) Passing: 208.6 yards per game (91st) Rushing: 208.2 yards per game (31st) Scoring: 30.4 points per game (69th) Liberty Defense Overall: 301.4 yards per game (32nd in FBS) Passing: 173.4 yards per game (29th) Rushing: 128 yards per game (56th) Scoring: 17.8 points per game (33rd) Sam Houston Offense Overall: 408 yards per game (57th in FBS) Passing: 308 yards per game (15th) Rushing: 100 yards per game (129th) Scoring: 27.8 points per game (76th) Sam Houston Defense Overall: 335.5 yards per game (57th in FBS) Passing: 145.3 yards per game (8th) Rushing: 190.3 yards per game (124th) Scoring: 24 points per game (76th) Both teams perform well defensively on third down. Liberty is 18th in the FBS, allowing opponents to convert 28.3% of the time. Sam Houston ranks 13th, allowing a 26.8% third down conversion rate. Liberty is 128th in the FBS averaging 79.6 penalty yards per game, compared to Sam Houston's 76th-ranked 59 per-game average. Sam Houston is 95th in FBS in red zone offense, scoring on 81.8% of trips. Liberty's red zone defense ranks 24th at 72.7%. Both teams rank high in time of possession. Liberty is 9th in the FBS with an average time of possession of 33:56, while Sam Houston's 22nd-ranked average is 33:02. Team leaders Liberty Passing: Deshawn Purdie, 936 yards, 7 TDs, 0 INTs, 60.0 completion percentage Rushing: Kam Davis, 457 yards on 64 carries, 3 TDs Receiving: Makai Jackson, 469 yards on 19 catches, 5 TDs Sam Houston Passing: Landyn Locke, 1,168 yards, 11 TDs, 3 INTs, 66.2 completion percentage Rushing: Alton McCaskill, 165 yards on 43 carries, 1 TD Receiving: Chris Reed, 220 yards on 11 catches, 3 TDs Last game Liberty beat Delaware 30-14 on Oct. 2. Purdie led Liberty with 157 yards on 13-of-20 passing (65.0%) for no touchdowns and no interceptions. Davis carried the ball 17 times for 147 yards and scored two touchdowns. Jackson had five receptions for 90 yards. Sam Houston fell to Texas Tech 49-14 on Sept. 26. Locke led Sam Houston with 195 yards on 23-of-37 passing (62.2%) for two touchdowns and two interceptions. He also carried the ball eight times for 25 yards. McCaskill carried the ball eight times for 25 yards, adding two receptions for seven yards. Tim Burns Jr. had two receptions for 61 yards and one touchdown. Next game Liberty plays at Kennesaw State on Oct. 22. Sam Houston hosts Western Kentucky on Oct. 14.
